Returns & Refunds

30-Day Hassle-Free Returns & Refunds.

We want you to be 100% satisfied with your Zavora Fashion purchase. If an item doesn't fit or meet your expectations, we offer simple 30-day returns with zero restocking fees.

1. 30-Day Return Window

You have 30 calendar days from the date your package is delivered to initiate a return or exchange request.

2. Item Condition Requirements

To be eligible for a return and full refund, items must be in their original condition: unworn, unwashed, unaltered, and with all original Zavora tags and packaging intact.

3. Return Shipping Costs & Restocking Fees

  • Restocking Fee: $0.00 (Zero Restocking Fee) on all returns.
  • Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items: If you received a defective or wrong item, return shipping is 100% FREE. We will provide a prepaid return label and issue a replacement or full refund immediately.
  • Customer Remorse / Size Changes: For voluntary returns (e.g. changed mind), the customer is responsible for the return postage.

4. Refund Processing Time

Once your returned package is received and inspected at our fulfillment center (typically within 1–2 business days), your refund will be issued back to your original payment method (PayPal or Credit/Debit Card). Financial institutions usually process this within 3–5 business days.

5. How to Initiate a Return

Simply email our customer support team at support@zavorafashion.com with your order number (#ZAV-...) and reason for return. Our support team will guide you through the quick return process within 24 hours.

Policy Summary
  • 30-day return window
  • $0 Restocking fee
  • Free returns on defective items
  • Fast 3-5 day refund processing
